text: {"components": [{"type": "obligation", "quote": "le Conseil fédéral peut arrêter", "gist": "The Federal Council may decide"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "lorsque la commercialisation doit être interdite ou assortie de conditions afin de protéger des intérêts publics prépondérants", "gist": "when marketing must be prohibited or subject to conditions to protect overriding public interests"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "la mise en place de ce principe a amorcé une réduction des entraves techniques au commerce, qui n’a pas eu d’effets délétères sur le niveau de protection", "gist": "the implementation of this principle initiated a reduction in technical barriers to trade, which had no harmful effects on the level of protection"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "principe Cassis de Dijon", "gist": "Cassis de Dijon principle"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "726 kB", "gist": "726 kilobytes"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "25.04.2013", "gist": "25 April 2013"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "SECO", "gist": "State Secretariat for Economic Affairs"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "étude (PDF)", "gist": "study (PDF)"}]}
